section.content: 本发明提供了一种半导体集成电路，该半导体集成电路能够在输入RAM存储的数据时使用的数据总线位数与输入数据的位数不同时，进行输入数据的数据总线的线选择。该半导体集成电路包括：数据总线D0～D7，其输入数据的K位(K是大于等于2的整数)；选择电路SEL(0)～SEL(13)，其根据由所述数据总线输入N位(N是小于K的整数)数据时设定的信号，选择通过所述数据总线的高位一侧的N条线和低位一侧的N条线中的一方进行输入的数据；以及RAM(随机存取存储器)(1)，其存储被选择电路选择的数据。

A semiconductor integrated circuit is provided which is capable of selecting lines of a data bus to which data is input when the number of bits of input data is different from the number of bits of the data bus with which to input data to be written into a RAM. The semiconductor integrated circuit comprises K-bit data bus lines D0 to D7 (K is an integer 2 or more) to which data is input; selection circuits SEL (0) to SEL (13) for selecting data input through an N number of the data bus lines on the high bit side or through an N number of the data bus lines on the low bit side based on a set signal when N-bit data is input into the data bus lines (N is an integer smaller than K); and a random access memory (RAM) 1 for storing data selected by the selection circuit.

Semiconductor integrated circuitTechnical field

Present invention relates in general to a kind of semiconductor integrated circuit, relate in particular to a kind of data and write RAM, again according to the semiconductor integrated circuit (lcd driver) of the data-driven LCD that reads from RAM input with built-in RAM.

Background technology

In the lcd driver of prior art, when the figure place of input data than the data/address bus figure place of using from the data of MPU input RAM storage after a little while, data allocations is given the high bit line of data/address bus.Fig. 4 is illustrated in the data/address bus in the lcd driver of prior art and the relation of data.Here the figure place around data/address bus is 8, and the situation the when figure place of data is 5 describes.

As shown in Figure 4, in existing lcd driver, provide 5 bit data R4～R0 by a high position 5 bit line D7～D3 among 8 bit line D7～D0 that data/address bus comprised, in addition, the data among low level 3 bit line D2～D0 are not because storage is advanced among the RAM, so, be expressed as sky data " * ".

But, according to user's specification requirement, need offer RAM to the data that are assigned to low bit line one side of data/address bus, in addition, because the figure place of data is also different, so, the configuration that all needs to change lcd driver at every turn.

Summary of the invention

In view of the above problems, the purpose of this invention is to provide a kind of semiconductor integrated circuit that can carry out line options to the data/address bus of input data, when data/address bus figure place that described semiconductor integrated circuit uses in the data of importing the RAM storage and the data bits of being imported are inconsistent, can carry out the line options of data/address bus.

For solving above problem, semiconductor integrated circuit involved in the present invention has following three parts, that is: the data/address bus of K position (K is the integer more than or equal to 2) is used to import data; Select circuit, its by bus input N position (N be the integer smaller or equal to K) data the time, according to the signal that sets, the data of selecting the side in the N bar line of the N bar line of a high position one side by bus or low level one side to import; RAM (random access memory), storage is by selecting the selected data of circuit.

Selection circuit herein can comprise: first selects circuit and second to select circuit, and this first selects circuit to be meant signal according to the figure place N setting of the corresponding data of importing, selects multidigit from the data of the N position imported; This second selects circuit, is meant the signal that high bit line and the needed side in the low bit line according to corresponding bus set, selects to select the N in the multidigit that circuit exports individual by first, to offer RAM.

Perhaps, select circuit to comprise: first selects circuit, it is according to the signal of setting corresponding to a needed side in the middle of the line of the line of a high position one side of bus and low level one side, select to pass through in the many lines of many lines of a high position one side of bus and low level one side either party the data imported; Second selects circuit, and the signal that it is set according to the figure place N corresponding to the input data from the data of the first selection circuit output, selects the N position to offer RAM.

According to the present invention of above formation, in being built-in with the semiconductor integrated circuit of RAM, the figure place that is stored in the figure place of the employed bus of data among the RAM and input data when input can be imported the line options of the bus of data when different.
